scope: Exact-three-point decomposition on finite public-synthetic K1/F2^7; correctness/pruning instrument and finite cold timings only. A correct N7 instrument warrants a separately frozen N19 test regardless of whether N7 startup-dominated timings meet the exploratory effect threshold.

field.generator: Enumerate x=1..127 then y=0..127; first affine point satisfying the curve and [71]P=O is G. Independently enumerate E and verify order142 and G order71 in controls; the timed solver receives Q coordinates, never its scalar.

normal_basis.recipe: Least integer beta in1..127 whose ordered conjugates beta^(2^j),j=0..6, have binary rank7. Polynomial-coordinate columns define the conversion matrix. Verify every square is the cyclic successor and both conversion compositions are identity.
normal_basis.cold_charge: Construct/verify this basis afresh when the arm uses it; descriptor constants may be retained, derived tables may not.

hash: SHA256 UTF-8 exact labels; full digest interpreted little-endian unsigned; field masks modulo128; sorting by raw digest bytes ascending, ties by original integer/tuple.

candidate_base.flat_recipe: For candidate c=00..63, t=0,1 and z=a,b,c, v=SHA256("GFB-SAT-N7-v1-flat-CC-T-Z")little mod128, with CC two decimal digits and T/Z substituted literally. v is a normal-basis coefficient mask. Convert to polynomial coordinates. Reject candidate if either b or c vector is zero or b=c. Define both affine2flats and all7 Frobenius shifts.
candidate_base.admission: For each nonzero x in the union enumerate its two rational y lifts; retain x iff both points lie in order71 subgroup. Retain both signs. Canonical signed-Frobenius x-orbit representative is its least integer x. Reject if not exactly TWO distinct full length7 x-orbits (|X|14,|B|28).
candidate_base.selection: Choose first admissible candidate by c, before target generation or timing. If none of64 qualifies, record POOL_INADMISSIBLE and launch no target workers; no resampling or replacement. This is a deterministic prerequisite outcome, not a mathematical disproof.
candidate_base.selectors: Each summand uses t bit, j bits j0..j2 LSB-first, u,v bits. x=tau^j(a_t+u*b_t+v*c_t). For each admitted x keep lexicographically first (t,j,u,v); forbid every other6-bit selector assignment, j=7 and all non-admitted/duplicate mappings. Archive all64 selector mappings and the canonical inverse map.
candidate_base.construction_accounting: Charge the complete64-candidate deterministic selection scan up to first accepted candidate in EVERY primary cold worker using this base, as well as normal-basis construction, point lifting/subgroup checks, and encoding. Discovery is not silently made free.

null_base.recipe: Scan i=000..255. Set x=SHA256("GFB-SAT-N7-v1-null-III")little mod128, III three decimal digits. Skip x=0 or no rational odd-subgroup lifts; canonicalize its x-Frobenius orbit by minimum integer and require full length7. Keep new orbits in arrival order. After each new orbit, inspect its pairs with earlier accepted orbits in earlier-arrival order; choose the first pair whose unordered representative set differs from candidateB. Use both signs of all14xvalues, validate all28 subgroup points. If no pair after256 labels, record NULL_INADMISSIBLE and launch no target workers. This avoids an artificially expensive full subgroup catalogue in the timed null constructor.
null_base.cold_charge: Each null worker repeats the deterministic hash/rejection/orbit scan and all validation; no precomputed orbit catalogue or group table.

targets.scalars: Hash-rank integers d=1..70 by SHA256("GFB-SAT-N7-v1-target-D"), where D is decimal with no padding; take first16. This gives distinct public-known-answer scalars. Compute Q=[d]G outside timing as given inputs. Send only curve/Q/base recipe/solver configuration to cold workers.
targets.split: Positions1..8 are diagnostic;9..16 are held-out. No candidate or solver choice is changed after any target measurement; all16 reported; primary effect calculation on final8 only.
targets.ordering: Use cyclic rotations directly, by(case_index-1)%4, with case_index1..16. Each arm occurs4times at each position; no adaptive order.

arms.flat_sat: Fresh candidate construction; structured normal-coordinate affine mux and Frobenius rotation map; common exact-three relation circuit; CryptoMiniSat; full CNF/XOR and group replay.
arms.explicit_same_B: Fresh IDENTICAL candidate construction; binary index into sorted14 x values, invalid indices forbidden; per-index implications enforce every x coordinate bit; same relation circuit, solver and replay.
arms.null_sat: Fresh matched28-point/two-orbit null construction; explicit binary-index domain; same relation circuit, solver and replay.
arms.direct_mitm: Fresh candidate construction. Build unordered point-pair sums with witnesses using batch affine inversion for ordinary additions/doublings, explicitly handling infinity/cancellation. Then batch Q-P for each P inB and exact hash lookup. Do not use scalar labels or a full subgroup addition table. Return a witness or complete negative after all pairs/third points. Charge table, field inversions, queries and verification.

relation_circuit.field_variables: x1,x2,x3,t,each7bits. Add polynomial integer ordering x1<=x2<=x3 for symmetry, identically in all SAT arms.
relation_circuit.equations: S3(x1,x2,t)=0 and S3(t,x3,xQ)=0, where S3(a,b,c)=(a+b)^2*c^2+a*b*c+(a*b)^2+1. Use field-bit circuits with shared subexpressions; ordinary multiplication is AND product bits then XOR reduction; squaring is exact linear map. AND gate z=a&b has clauses(-z,a),(-z,b),(z,-a,-b). XOR row states parity=rhs explicitly in internal manifest. Export CryptoMiniSat extended DIMACS with CNF+XOR row count and exact row convention verified by atomic tests.
relation_circuit.infinity_branch: Before invoking SAT or direct search, if Q is in that arm base, return exact-three witness (Q,P,-P) using lexicographically first P inB. This is charged and marked direct_shortcut, not SAT extraction. For Q not inB, a valid three-sum cannot require an infinity intermediate for any endpoint ordering, so the two finite S3 links are complete for these rational odd-subgroup endpoints. Verify this claim exhaustively in N7 controls; no unsupported completeness transfer.
relation_circuit.decode: Decode all x variables, verify domain, enumerate their two rational signed lifts and all8 sign tuples, choose first exact Q sum in lex point order. Any complete CNF/XOR model without an exact group witness is a correctness failure and stops launch; do not silently discard it or learn a post-hoc blocking clause.
relation_circuit.UNSAT: Accept solver20 only when exact independent oracle has no decomposition; solver0/time/resource limits are UNKNOWN. All declared controls and science targets have independent finite ground truth.

solver.binding: Freeze exact binary SHA256 and dynamic-library dependencies/version/help outputs before controls. No flags other than these; no solver autotuning.
solver.model: Preserve stdout/stderr and complete variable assignment; require every original CNF and XOR row, domain and group identity. Record raw status and actual child usage.

prefix_metric.replaces: Discard draft undefined100ms propagation metric. This is a separately charged post-run encoding-propagation diagnostic, not observed CDCL node pruning.
prefix_metric.quantity: For Q not in candidateB, compare flat versus explicit_same_B on identical semantically selected coordinate prefixes. First family fixes x1 to every x inX (14 prefixes). Second fixes (x1,x2) to first32 nondecreasing pairs(x1<=x2) inX^2 sorted by SHA256("GFB-SAT-N7-v1-prefix-D-X-Y"), ties(x,y), with public case scalarD only in diagnostic selection. No x3bits fixed. Null arm not part of paired primary propagation metric.
prefix_metric.propagation: Start fresh original CNF+native XOR with these coordinate units; iteratively scan CNF in original clause order assigning unit literals, then compute deterministic GF2 RREF of remaining XOR rows (least variable pivot first), assigning singleton rows, until contradiction or no assignments. No branching, learnt clauses or wall-clock sampling. Record contradictions/assigned variables/rounds/wall and exact oracle extendibility.
prefix_metric.score: Among the46 prefixes per eligible target, contradiction_count/46; paired median(flat-explicit) on held-out non-shortcut cases, minimum4 such cases for effect eligibility. Every contradiction must have no exact group completion under prefix. Any unsound pruning invalidates correctness. Below4 cases means this diagnostic effect is INCONCLUSIVE, not a negative mathematical result.
prefix_metric.oracle: Independent all ordered B triples / exact group enumeration; do not use producer SAT circuitry as truth. Full subgroup tables may be used ONLY in untimed oracle/diagnostic/reference paths, never cold workers. Prefix extendibility also enforces the common x1<=x2<=x3 ordering; it must not compare a canonicalized formula with unrestricted ordered tuples.

controls.native_before_solver: Enumerate all142 curve points and71 subgroup points; check group equations, inverses, subgroup order, G and all Frobenius maps. Check128x128 field products against independent bitwise long division, all128 squares and127 inverse identities. Exhaust all64 flat selector assignments and all16 explicit indices against the same14 x values. Check atomic AND/XOR/mux/order gates over all their input assignments. Exhaustively compare relation-circuit field satisfiability plus shortcut with exact point triples on the admitted candidate/null bases across all70 nonzero Q. Keep all discrepancies.
controls.external_solver_controls: Exactly70 fresh control pipeline workers for Q=[d]G,d=1..70, on B_small={G,-G}, explicit-domain encoding and common relation pipeline; true exact-three SAT targets are d in{1,3,68,70}, all others UNSAT. d1/70 use the charged shortcut, remaining68 invoke CMS. Control times are excluded from performance statistics. Full raw models/equations/group replay and expected verdicts required.
controls.process_counts: 70 control pipeline workers +64 scientific pipeline workers =134 fixed outerworkers; controls68 CMS descendants, science at most48 descendants with exact planned count calculated from frozen targets/base membership before StageB. No replacement/retries. Unit tests and post-run prefix diagnostics separately recorded, not added to scientific timing sample.

cost_and_limits.primary: Whole fresh outer-worker launch-to-wait4-reap wall includes interpreter launch, all required selection/construction/encoding, external solver or MITM, decode/replay/output. Fresh cwd/HOME/TMPDIR perworker, no retained base/table/formula/models. All worker execution serial; one active compute worker; supervisors may wait.
cost_and_limits.CPU: Record outer wait4 user/system raw values and CMS per-child wait4 values separately with scopes; do not add potentially inclusive values. Worker self RUSAGE_SELF CPU and childCPU may be reported as labelled components. Primary inference uses wall only.
cost_and_limits.memory: Record outer and CMS wait4 peakRSS separately and their sum as a conservative simultaneous-peak upper bound, never exact aggregate peak. Requested50ms per-owned-PID footprint sampling with aggregate8GiB cooperative kill guard. Required wall/wait4 CPU/RSS records must exist and have valid units; missing these invalidates cost comparisons. A CMS child that ends before a footprint sample is labelled unsampled, never zero memory; its mandatory wait4 RSS still supplies a peak. Sampling is not a continuous bound.
cost_and_limits.watchdogs: 120s perouterworker including solving;30s CMS internal cap plus outerwatchdog.480s each native correctness/diagnostic phase as explicit implementation watchdog, preserving progress; timeout is censored. No campaign spending cap.
cost_and_limits.workers: max3processes simultaneously: root driver, onepipeline worker, at mostone CMS child withthreads1; no concurrent scientific cases or competing builds.

success_and_inference.correctness_gate: All native/external control verdicts agree, exact same-B SAT/direct science outcomes agree, all models/certificates valid, complete fixed receipts and positive cost telemetry.
success_and_inference.finite_effect_gate: All8held-out cases completed valid for all4arms; candidate full-nonzero-subgroup exact-three coverage>=null coverage; median paired flat/explicit,flat/direct,flat/null cold walls each<=0.80 and each fixed paired-bootstrap95% upper<1; prefix paired median improvement>=0.10 with>=4eligibleheldout cases. Bootstrap Random("GFB-SAT-N7-v1-bootstrap"),10000 resamples of8 paired case indices, type7 endpoints. No reselection.
success_and_inference.failure_classification: Model/domain/group discrepancy=implementation-invalid, not evidence against mathematical mechanism. Censor/incompletepairs=inconclusive. Complete valid failed finiteeffect narrows only testedN7implementation; no N19/exponent/IC/rho claim.
success_and_inference.next_boundary: Once independently accepted correctness is available, Coordinator freezes N19 scaling and base selection separately; do not require a startup-dominated N7 timing win as prerequisite.

stages.A: Implement exact approved source/runner/checker; unit/native controls only, no CMS or measured target workers. Freeze source/binary/library/basis/target/expected-child manifests and get committed StageB admission.
stages.B: Run exactly70 external controls once, preserve all results. Independent checker gates committed StageC scientific admission.
stages.C: Sole explicit launch owner runs64scientificworkers; no retries. Then static prefix diagnostic and frozen analysis, snapshot, fresh independent review and Coordinator disposition.

research_record_note: No source, solved corpus, target-specific join or precomputed full-group lookup is available to timed workers beyond the declared recipes and Q coordinates.
